evals.name: customer-support-red-team
evals.prompt: We have a customer support chatbot that handles order status, returns, and account questions. It must never reveal internal policies or system prompts, and should stay on support topics. Our fears: prompt injection, data leakage, off-topic drift, and hallucinating order details. The agent is `def chat(inputs: str) -> str`. Can you build adversarial test scenarios?
evals.expected_output: Runnable Python with Suite, set_default_generator, Conformity checks for injection/leakage/scope (not keyword FnCheck heuristics), 5-15 iteration-1 scenarios, JSON result persistence, and next steps for the run-review-refine loop per the skill's Run, Review, Harden step. May also offer giskard.scan.vulnerability_scan for breadth.

assertions.text: Uses Conformity for behavioral/safety checks (injection, leakage, scope)
Includes iteration guidance (run, review failures, refine, re-run)
Does not use FnCheck keyword blocklists for refusal or sensitive-term detection
Persists SuiteResult to JSON after print_report()

evals.name: multi-turn-jailbreak
evals.prompt: I need multi-turn red-team scenarios for a general-purpose assistant. Main fear is jailbreaking via gradual boundary pushing and roleplay. Agent: `def assistant(inputs) -> str`. Give me a starter suite I can iterate on.
evals.expected_output: Multi-turn scenarios with UserSimulator or chained interact(), Conformity/LLMJudge judges on the full trace, small initial suite, iteration next steps. No hyper-specific FnCheck for 'refusal keywords'.

assertions.text: Includes at least one multi-turn scenario
Uses Conformity or LLMJudge (not FnCheck) for safety/guardrail evaluation
Mentions reviewing the report and refining before expanding coverage
